reason: The first reading took prerogativa for Pragmatica and Misericordia for Omnia and left line ends open; rereading with Rufinus's edition and two manuscripts of the Summa fixed the lemmata and located all four strips in one distinction.

Reread on the image by a research reader: all of panels C, D and strip A; lines 2 and 10-14 of strip B. Not read: the two out-of-focus panels of canvas 0; lines 1, 3-9, 15 of strip B. Accuracy has not been measured.
